snippet.title: Chikn Nuggit Your Nightmare Fwiend - Trailer
snippet.description:
This is a teaser trailer to Chikn Nuggit Nightmare Fwiends by Alex Gochev.
Chikn Nuggit by Kyra Kupetsky / BuzzFeed Animation Lab

After the past months, i'm finally about to finish making my own horror game.
